*Thinking in my own voice as the farmer...*

Well, I've been on this land for 50 years now. Just me and the old lady at home — the kids moved to the city years ago and send a little money back, but the farm still matters. 6 mu isn't much, but it's what I know. At my age I'm not going to try anything fancy — what works, works.

I split the land like I always do: about 4 mu for wheat-maize double cropping, and 2 mu for cotton. Wheat-maize is our food and grain cash, cotton is the money crop for buying things through the year. I've thought about dropping cotton since picking kills my back now — but the old lady and I can still manage 2 mu between us, and that cotton cash matters.

**Wheat (4 mu):** I'll plant around the 5th-10th of October when the soil cools, same window as everyone in our village. I buy improved seed from the ag station each year — about 8 kg/mu, costs around 35 yuan/mu. Before planting I spread around 50 kg of compound fertilizer (15-15-15) per mu as base — that comes to about 150 yuan/mu. Then at green-up to jointing in spring I topdress 15 kg of urea per mu. I irrigate three times usually — winter water in December, green-up water in late February, and jointing water in April. If May is dry I'll add a fourth at grain filling, but that pump water costs about 30 yuan/mu each time so I don't add one unless I have to. Light herbicide spray in spring for the wild wheat, maybe one aphid spray if I see them. Custom combine comes through in early June at harvest — I pay 40 yuan/mu for that, my back can't do the sickle work anymore. Expect around 420 kg/mu, that's what I got last year.

**Maize (4 mu, same land):** This is the tight one. Wheat comes off around June 8th-12th, I've got maybe 5-7 days to get maize in the ground. I pay the custom operator 40 yuan/mu to plant with his no-till machine right into the wheat stubble — at 72 I don't even pretend I can do it by hand anymore. I use hybrid seed, Zhengdan or whatever the neighbors are getting good results with, about 25 yuan/mu. Base fertilizer 30 kg compound at planting with the seed, then 15 kg of urea topdress at big trumpet stage around early August. Usually one irrigation in July if the rains don't come, maybe two if it's a dry summer. One herbicide spray after planting for weeds. Expect 450 kg/mu. Harvest end of September, same custom operator comes with a sheller.

**Cotton (2 mu):** Plant mid-April, around the 15th-20th. Been using the same local hybrid variety several years — works here, about 50 yuan/mu for seed. Cotton takes less than the grains for N — I put down about 35 kg compound at planting and topdress 15 kg urea at flowering. Irrigate once or twice depending on summer rain. The hard part is the pests — I spray 4-5 times through the season for bollworm, aphids, and spider mites. That costs maybe 80 yuan/mu in chemicals. Picking is me and my wife starting late September, we go through the field three or four times through October. That's 30-plus days of our labor, no way to hire at those rates for 2 mu. Expect about 250 kg lint/mu if the weather cooperates.

I keep things simple. The rates I've worked out over the years give decent yields without wasting money. We don't have cash to experiment and at my age I'm not going to start now. My neighbor's son has been trying some drip irrigation setup — I watch but I'm not changing.
